top_mode.description: Enable 'top' mode, refresh display on each update.

long_name.description: Report long process name from /proc/pid/cmdline (all args).

short_name.description: Report short process name from /proc/pid/cmdline (process name only).

strip_path.description: Strip full directory path off the process name in CSV output.

timestamp.description: Add timestamp (the 'whence' info) to the output.

brief.description: Just report events, PID and process name.

cumulative.description: Report cumulative events rather than events per sample period.

sample_count.description: Report the sample event count in the CSV output rather than the default events per second rate.

stats.description: Report the minimum, maximum, average and population standard deviation at the end of the CSV output.

csv_file.description: Path to CSV output file (for -r option).

threshold.description: Ignore samples where the event delta per second is less than this threshold.

max_events.description: Only display the first N top events (top N).

delay.description: Sample interval in seconds (first positional argument).

count.description: Number of samples to collect (second positional argument). 0 means unlimited.
